objective: Build a winter traffic engine before seasonal demand arrives while keeping live-condition claims source-safe.

source.windowCaution: The observed values are preseason/off-season signals. They are evidence of early discovery, not a forecast of winter traffic.

xcLive.sourceOwnership: The current main repository does not own the deployed XC source. The adapter remains fail-closed until that source is recovered.

newAuthoritySurface.intent: Broad Michigan XC trail planning and discovery
newAuthoritySurface.antiCannibalizationRule: The main-domain guide must not claim to be the live grooming report. The live XC app owns conditions-today intent; the guide owns statewide planning intent.

by2026-10-15: XC guide receiving query impressions before regular snow season
by2026-11-15: Establish a Search Console baseline for the new authority hub
Recover or identify ownership of the xcski production source
Confirm live XC-to-guide and guide-to-live handoff works in production

activeSeason.decisionPrinciple: Optimize for qualified clicks and useful second-page movement, not raw impressions alone.

competitiveGap: Michigan DNR points skiers to multiple third-party condition-report sources. The product opportunity is a single Michigan-first decision flow that uses snow as a regional signal and operator grooming reports as the trail-level truth.
safetyBoundary: Weather, snow depth, freezing degree days and satellite ice cover are context. They never become an unsupported claim that a ski trail is groomed or that ice is safe.
